name: business-command-ai
description: Business Command AI — an AI business command center: connect business accounts, ask questions by voice or text, and build live dashboards.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:api -w @bca/server" "npm run dev:worker -w @bca/server" "npm run dev -w @bca/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bca/server && npm run build -w @bca/web
